It is distinct from GO:0160067, the new-SPB SIN signaling complex active in anaphase, and from GO:1990334, the narrower two-component GAP complex. No part_of link to the old mitotic SPB is asserted here because GO:0160066 says the complex is associated with that SPB rather than declaring a proper-parthood relation.
gap-0977b8431dc53044f96ffb966c1e3ae59bdd.resolution_note: Curated GO:0160066 as an exact record with GO:0160065 parentage and left old-SPB localization as evidence-backed scope rather than as a parthood edge.

gap-0a10c449977e9a1801bab669e0a32dc3d9f5.rationale: Cortical depth and source version affect how colocalization can be interpreted.

gap-0adbfab5757ab9b9e1d1eb9d3f3f3c63fe7f.prompt: Should SecDF-YajC and YidC be folded into the SecYEG translocon record or modeled as constituents of a larger SecYEG-SecDF-YajC-YidC holo-translocon?

The larger holo-translocon is therefore a distinct supercomplex that has the SecYEG core as a named part.
gap-0adbfab5757ab9b9e1d1eb9d3f3f3c63fe7f.resolution_note: Keep SecD, SecF, YajC, and YidC in the larger SecYEG-SecDF-YajC-YidC holo-translocon record and point back to the SecYEG core with has_part.

gap-0b13254f9b0a50fd80599ed6bfa00201bdd6.prompt: Keep the microsporidian-type exospore separate from the bacterial exosporium.
gap-0b13254f9b0a50fd80599ed6bfa00201bdd6.rationale: GO:0090642 denotes the outer layer of a microsporidian spore wall, whereas bacterial exosporia are optional outer layers of bacterial endospore coats that occur in a different spore architecture.

gap-0b74cff50375bb8458e4c880e14bfcabd5b6.prompt: Resolve native client inventories, material state, prevalence and exact strain mapping for older assays.
gap-0b74cff50375bb8458e4c880e14bfcabd5b6.rationale: Induced reporter observations do not establish universal dimensions, composition or lineage distribution.

gap-0b7bc826580754b4b147632ed39ce0de275c.rationale: An unlabeled TEM preview cannot establish protein identity, calcium transport or calibrated dimensions.

gap-0b89329d93e95cb6dfefc2f28af9401b29d4.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for kinetoplast maxicircles, minicircles and KAP protein cohorts, if such terms exist.
gap-0b89329d93e95cb6dfefc2f28af9401b29d4.rationale: The first kinetoplast record keeps kDNA circle classes and KAPs label-only to avoid guessing Sequence Ontology or protein-family CURIEs for kinetoplastid-specific grouped components.

gap-0ba0cba1e83a4278312ac890ed36d96b0c9c.prompt: Identify transport substrates, transporters and division machinery directly.
gap-0ba0cba1e83a4278312ac890ed36d96b0c9c.rationale: Metabolic and cellular integration do not establish molecular mechanisms.

gap-0bb7b4ed5d66f20853dc6b8c0b4f5acfe2a6.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0031969, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-0bd0f358f82ef0d21803951161dba82a614c.rationale: The first GO-backed inner-plaque record captures the lamina as a named SPB substructure without guessing exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or Complex Portal groundings for the budding-yeast plaque proteins and associated gamma-tubulin complexes.

gap-0bd7a46029a600d37dd1141be024761b5c6b.prompt: Keep the endocytic clathrin coat as a vesicle membrane part rather than a lipid-bilayer membrane component.
gap-0bd7a46029a600d37dd1141be024761b5c6b.rationale: GO:0030128 denotes the clathrin protein coat on the endocytic vesicle, whereas GO:0030669 denotes the lipid bilayer surrounding that vesicle.
gap-0bd7a46029a600d37dd1141be024761b5c6b.resolution_note: Represented only a reviewed-label-only lipid bilayer as a direct membrane component and left the endocytic clathrin coat to the GO:0030128 record.

gap-0c00e688f41315ca27a064e2f767d1977c8c.prompt: Reconcile experimental conditions and isolate the distal fiber's contribution to flagellar coordination.
gap-0c00e688f41315ca27a064e2f767d1977c8c.rationale: Multistructure mutants cannot by themselves establish a distal-fiber-specific necessity or absence of function.

gap-0c47e388030a232eb6483a188e2b85da388b.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the PapA, PapG, PapF, PapE, PapK, and PapH constituent subunits.
gap-0c47e388030a232eb6483a188e2b85da388b.rationale: The record intentionally uses reviewed labels for the E. coli P pilus subunits until InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam accessions can be verified without overclaiming a broader chaperone-usher domain as an exact subunit family.

gap-0c7d0833c8eeb066444ee4d015acce4e8039.prompt: Represent Saccharomyces cerevisiae DNA polymerase delta as a monomeric Pol3/Pol31/Pol32 heterotrimer rather than a dimer of heterotrimers.
gap-0c7d0833c8eeb066444ee4d015acce4e8039.rationale: The GO definition for GO:0043625 still says that the active Saccharomyces enzyme is a dimer of heterotrimers. Johansson et al. revisited that earlier gel-filtration model with gel filtration, glycerol-gradient sedimentation, analytical equilibrium centrifugation, and two-hybrid analyses and concluded that the Pol3/Pol31/Pol32 assembly is monomeric.
gap-0c7d0833c8eeb066444ee4d015acce4e8039.resolution_note: The record lists Pol3, Pol31 and Pol32 once and does not curate a dimeric stoichiometry row.

gap-0ccd86a6ce4fbd3eb6efdd04839a31587312.prompt: Represent alphaA and alphaC as isoforms of one AP-2 alpha subunit class.
gap-0ccd86a6ce4fbd3eb6efdd04839a31587312.rationale: The GO definition notes that human AP-2 can be heterogeneric because alphaA and alphaC isoforms are encoded by different genes. The taxon-agnostic component list therefore keeps one AP-2 alpha subunit class rather than making human paralogs separate core component classes.

gap-0d2a6261be121144d2a3a4a7c3f7667cbbdd.prompt: Find exact source-neutral whole-protein mappings for four label-only classes.
gap-0d2a6261be121144d2a3a4a7c3f7667cbbdd.rationale: Complete InterPro matches were inspected for Mto1 O94488, Mto2 Q9USP7, Alp7 Q9URY2 and Rsp1 O13601. Domains and superfamilies are not whole-protein family equivalents. Rsp1 has a broad family annotation, but no exact mapping to the narrower class is adopted. Mto2's empty API response is not absence of homologs; divergent fungal homologs are discussed in the 2015 primary study. Alp14 uses the verified XMAP215 family, not a TOG domain.

aliases: translocation and assembly module protein complex
gap-0da66d86790efaaf8ad4c7e266552cc07a8b.prompt: Curate a TAM function row only after deciding whether the record should use a narrow autotransporter biogenesis wording or a broader adhesin-protein secretion wording.
gap-0da66d86790efaaf8ad4c7e266552cc07a8b.rationale: GO:0097347 labels TAM as a protein secretion complex, while the definition paper discovered it through efficient secretion of autotransporter adhesins; the first record therefore avoids overclaiming a generic type V secretion function.

gap-0daa6089d19f688527eb06de3115ce6129c6.prompt: Resolve the exact source-neutral RNA and protein-family boundaries for SL snRNP components.
gap-0daa6089d19f688527eb06de3115ce6129c6.rationale: The first GO:0071024 record captures only the GO-defined spliced leader RNA and associated-protein cohorts. Exact RNA terminology and SL snRNP protein-family boundaries should be resolved before expanding the component list.

gap-0e1cf00308aa98eab997e3afc6663cf95b4b.prompt: Separate the Hsp78 oligomer from its subunit, cooperating chaperones and potential clients.
gap-0e1cf00308aa98eab997e3afc6663cf95b4b.rationale: Hsp78 is one gene product but forms a distinct mitochondrial oligomer. Copurification does not establish invariant structural membership.
gap-0e1cf00308aa98eab997e3afc6663cf95b4b.resolution_note: Mint the assembly identity after bounded native QuickGO and OLS GO label/synonym searches for Hsp78, ClpB and Hsp100 did not return an exact term. The broad chaperone-complex parent is not equivalent. Keep Ssc1, Mdj1, potential substrates and post-lysis contaminants outside canonical composition; no fixed Hsp78-Hsp70 heteromer is demonstrated. Whole-worktree hidden/ignored-inclusive searches and parsed identity fields of all 885 pre-existing records found no Hsp78 duplicate.

gap-0eac615353337bf542070063eed485db64a9.prompt: Resolve exact A1-A13 protofilament boundaries, non-inner-sheath A-tubule MIP positions, radial-spoke and dynein-arm attachment geometry, source-neutral tubulin-family groundings and copy numbers for the A axonemal microtubule.
gap-0eac615353337bf542070063eed485db64a9.rationale: GO exactly identifies the A axonemal microtubule, but this pass curates only its coarse role in the outer doublet and leaves exact protofilament, MIP, radial-spoke and dynein-arm attachment placement unresolved. Reassessment on 2026-10-11: GO exactly identifies the A axonemal microtubule and GO:0160111 now captures the A-tubule inner sheath, but this pass curates only the A tubule's coarse role in the outer doublet and leaves exact protofilament, non-inner-sheath MIP, radial-spoke and dynein-arm attachment placement unresolved.

gap-0eac8395d4af6465866ecae0746c1f8b6839.rationale: This first GO-backed record captures the anaphase new-SPB SIN signaling complex without guessing InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, UniProtKB, or Complex Portal groundings for fission-yeast-specific protein names.

gap-0eee64437d77d391fb27601ed417c84b2365.prompt: Keep this record scoped to the bacterial dimeric RNase P complex and curate multimeric archaeal, nucleolar and mitochondrial RNase P complexes separately.
gap-0eee64437d77d391fb27601ed417c84b2365.rationale: GO separates the single-RNA/single-protein dimeric complex from multimeric and organellar RNase P variants. This first record intentionally models only GO:0030680.

gap-0f375d8b2b8a9a5753acaebe94c1746cd5ee.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for Nup57, Nup49, and Nsp1 central-channel nucleoporins.
gap-0f375d8b2b8a9a5753acaebe94c1746cd5ee.rationale: The first central-channel record avoids guessing one exact InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam accession for fungal channel Nup classes whose orthology and FG-repeat boundaries need a dedicated pass.

gap-0f3ebc5d2182dd0711f6f8e579e30482c867.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein-family boundaries for multimeric RNase P complexes.
gap-0f3ebc5d2182dd0711f6f8e579e30482c867.rationale: The first GO:0030681 record captures the GO-defined single-RNA, several-protein composition at cohort granularity. Exact protein families and the boundary between archaeal multimeric RNase P and organellar variants should be resolved before assigning protein groundings.

gap-0f72989a6a2e9d1e700b3030585bab57fa74.prompt: Do not model Asf1 as a constituent of the HIR complex.
gap-0f72989a6a2e9d1e700b3030585bab57fa74.rationale: Green et al. 2005 reported that Hir1, Hir2, Hir3 and Hpc2 comprise the budding-yeast HIR complex and that this complex copurifies with Asf1, supporting Asf1 as a histone-deposition partner rather than one of the four HIR constituents.
gap-0f72989a6a2e9d1e700b3030585bab57fa74.resolution_note: Declined: Asf1 cooperates and copurifies with HIR during histone deposition, but the HIR complex itself is curated as Hir1, Hir2, Hir3 and Hpc2.

gap-0f8e26f0b8686adf973bd40db1cc4096fbd2.prompt: Is Prli42 a universal core constituent or a demonstrated channel?
gap-0f8e26f0b8686adf973bd40db1cc4096fbd2.rationale: Neither claim is made. Native co-isolation of RsbR and RsbS, fractionation and perturbation justify Listeria-associated membrane machinery. The direct-versus-indirect tether mechanism and localization of every intact assembled particle are not resolved by RsbR fractionation. Prli42 is absent from the reconstituted core and its proposed channel role is speculative.

gap-0f9e6219c93491e7f57861526eac997fd840.prompt: Interpret combined culture identifiers using specimen annotations rather than filenames alone.
gap-0f9e6219c93491e7f57861526eac997fd840.rationale: Co-embedded cultures are not synonyms or proof that both organisms possess the structure.

gap-0fa37548ee6ac43574c242de6048577fbaae.prompt: Represent the phagocytic vesicle membrane as the boundary of the lumen rather than as a lumen component.
gap-0fa37548ee6ac43574c242de6048577fbaae.rationale: GO:0097013 denotes the lumenal volume enclosed by the phagocytic vesicle membrane, not a stable molecular constituent table. The membrane is therefore modeled as a boundary node in the topology graph.
gap-0fa37548ee6ac43574c242de6048577fbaae.resolution_note: Curated the membrane as a boundary node and left the lumen record without constituent components.

gap-0fbc4aae6aeb60fd4454527adf801bd740bb.rationale: The mature GO:0009427 L ring is the FlgH ring at the outer-membrane side of the LP-ring bushing. FlgI forms the adjacent P ring, the FlgG distal rod runs through the bushing, lipopolysaccharide and the cell outer membrane host the L ring, and FlgA and FlgJ act during outer-ring or rod assembly rather than remaining constituents of the mature L ring.

gap-0fc721ec1c36fad9e65b1635a1e71deb8afd.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Rad7 and Rad16 constituents of the NEF4 complex.
gap-0fc721ec1c36fad9e65b1635a1e71deb8afd.rationale: GO:0000113 defines budding-yeast Rad7p and Rad16p as the NEF4 constituents. Exact cross-eukaryotic InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family boundaries for these NER factor classes need narrower curation before these component labels can be grounded.

gap-0fe35e721279485de002cdf31ed32fe3ef91.prompt: Do not infer a tubulin-binding reaction from basal-body YL1/2 staining.
gap-0fe35e721279485de002cdf31ed32fe3ef91.rationale: YL1/2 recognition of RP2 confounds interpreting disappearance of the basal-body signal as loss of a tubulin pool.

gap-1000b4d92aebc4c5877a3e07edd99d10b596.prompt: Decide whether individual glyoxylate-cycle enzymes belong in the glyoxysome component table.
gap-1000b4d92aebc4c5877a3e07edd99d10b596.rationale: Isocitrate lyase, malate synthase and related glyoxylate-cycle enzymes are matrix cargo rather than structural constituents of the glyoxysome membrane-bounded compartment.
gap-1000b4d92aebc4c5877a3e07edd99d10b596.resolution_note: Matrix metabolic enzymes were left out of components because they are functional cargo, not the physical boundary of the organelle.

gap-1010303313716ece56522fca6e05b37f206d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral Imp1, Imp2, and Som1 family groundings before adding IMP component rows.

gap-10267c63de383479ede03949fecde622fd72.prompt: Resolve exact lipid species or lipid classes for the late endosome membrane before expanding molecular composition.

gap-1050eed7c79c95881803adc8cf42020f65ab.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for septin-filament-array septin proteins.

gap-106f516a377a85a321527677e2aa292bd8f3.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings and essentiality calls for Csm1, Lrs4, Hrr25 and Mam1 within the budding-yeast monopolin complex.

gap-1080741048e07e8f74a0a10778baa3822700.prompt: Keep variable phagocytosed cargo and maturation enzymes out of the generic phagocytic vesicle lumen components.
gap-1080741048e07e8f74a0a10778baa3822700.rationale: The phagocytic vesicle lumen is the bounded volume inside the vesicle. The ingested particle and soluble hydrolases depend on phagosome cargo and maturation stage, so this generic lumen record does not assert a stable cargo or enzyme component.

gap-10833d66342d0798e3d646e72cd2ff7d7bab.prompt: Keep the germ tube septin cap distinct from the generic septin cap, the hyphal cap, and germ-tube septation-site rings.

GO:0032159 denotes the broader hyphal-or-germ-tube septin-cap class, GO:0032164 denotes the hyphal cap sibling, and GO:0032172 denotes a ring-shaped septin structure at future germ-tube septation sites.
gap-10833d66342d0798e3d646e72cd2ff7d7bab.resolution_note: Curated GO:0032171 as the exact germ tube septin-cap structure, used GO:0032159 as its is-a parent, used GO:0032179 as its direct part_of target, and kept hyphal caps and germ-tube septation-site rings outside this record.

gap-10f4167e386a6ac6984d351f4b4d5df15c14.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for Sec62, Sec63, Sec71/Sec66, and Sec72 before changing these component rows from reviewed labels to grounded families.
gap-10f4167e386a6ac6984d351f4b4d5df15c14.rationale: GO exactly grounds the Sec62/Sec63 complex and its yeast Sec62p, Sec63p, Sec71p, and Sec72p constituents, but exact source-neutral family CURIEs were not curated in this pass.

gap-110ad5238682149c791c47ce220ea5b0c732.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for inner-arm dynein heavy-chain isoforms and accessory subunits.
gap-110ad5238682149c791c47ce220ea5b0c732.rationale: GO exactly identifies the inner dynein arm as a complex, but this curation pass did not verify exact InterPro, Pfam or other source-neutral accessions for the cross-taxon inner-arm chain classes or the Chlamydomonas heavy-chain isoforms.

gap-110c9af56ac8815d44065669bad23bcf759b.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Rad9, Rad1 and Hus1 constituents of the checkpoint clamp complex.
gap-110c9af56ac8815d44065669bad23bcf759b.rationale: GO:0030896 exactly identifies the conserved Rad9-Rad1-Hus1 clamp, but exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProtKB family boundaries for the three fission-yeast-modeled subunit classes need narrower follow-up curation.

gap-112105fb6f6958bb5b237d27f3a6d20aedb8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral RNA and protein boundaries for individual spliceosomal snRNP complexes.
gap-112105fb6f6958bb5b237d27f3a6d20aedb8.rationale: The first GO:0097525 record captures only the SO-grounded snRNA class and the associated-protein cohort inherited from the small-nuclear-ribonucleoprotein parent. Individual major and minor spliceosomal snRNP records should resolve specific U-series RNAs, Sm or Lsm rings and snRNP-specific protein family boundaries separately.

gap-113b4dfaebbba49adb8478c4f6272fbb4a6e.prompt: Should BasEF or BasABC be curated as constituents of the mature bindosome complex?
gap-113b4dfaebbba49adb8478c4f6272fbb4a6e.rationale: GO:7770042 identifies the bindosome as the assembled sugar-binding-protein complex. Zolghadr et al. showed that BasEF and BasABC are type-IV-pilin-like machinery required for functional surface localization of the sugar-binding proteins; BasEF was not required for formation of the extracted 400 and 600 kDa complexes themselves. gap-113e1526a7240424293860d9c93c10155067.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the six yeast TRAPPI core subunits.
gap-113e1526a7240424293860d9c93c10155067.rationale: This first TRAPPI record names the yeast Bet3, Bet5, Trs20, Trs23, Trs31 and Trs33 constituent subunits but leaves InterPro, Pfam, or Complex Portal grounding unset until exact orthology and paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-11453758f5e6e1aeb7e562598e903f636a1a.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the mating projection membrane.
gap-11453758f5e6e1aeb7e562598e903f636a1a.rationale: GO:0070250 identifies the whole mating projection membrane, but the lipid-bilayer constituent is intentionally left as reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-domain CURIE is curated.

gap-119af126d3f8351dca69f9deb5c9c91826bc.prompt: Model the capsule constituent as a broad extracellular polymer rather than forcing every capsule into polysaccharide chemistry.
gap-119af126d3f8351dca69f9deb5c9c91826bc.rationale: Most curated examples are polysaccharide-rich, but the GO capsule term also covers chemically different organized capsules such as the Bacillus poly-D-glutamate capsule. The schema lacks a peptide-polymer enum value, so this record uses OTHER with reviewed-label grounding.

gap-11e70ac5bf855afbd56addaff24bfda14e23.prompt: Resolve exact connector-centrin family grounding and the remaining scaffold composition.
gap-11e70ac5bf855afbd56addaff24bfda14e23.rationale: A verified protein example does not define a cross-taxon family or a full molecular inventory.

gap-120f4117cf85ced6cf161eca871e08ab61fc.prompt: Keep the nitroplast distinct from a whole host, a microbial taxon and the diazoplast.
gap-120f4117cf85ced6cf161eca871e08ab61fc.rationale: A compartment record must not turn a lineage name into an unrestricted structural synonym.

gap-1231225f63d3bb92300ba2cf8d8ed4ffaabc.prompt: Should glycine reductase protein C be split into taxon-specific GrdC and GrdD subunits with exact family groundings?
gap-1231225f63d3bb92300ba2cf8d8ed4ffaabc.rationale: GO:0030700 models glycine reductase protein C as one of the three usual glycine reductase components, but the C. sticklandii grd operon encodes both large and small subunits of protein C. gap-3cc1e4f1913ec07aea5b758894c2085fcdcb.rationale: GO groups inducing conditions, but this does not make experimental mechanisms interchangeable.

gap-4285c6a366c8423a709e6917d42a2287cd04.prompt: Avoid mixing biological dimensions, experimental expansion and control cells.
gap-4285c6a366c8423a709e6917d42a2287cd04.rationale: Bundle length, thickness and maturation timing vary with condition; the 2024 Results and Discussion describe different approximate times for full stabilization. gap-42d2b63261b5bc9f2f075d24311ce577b2f2.prompt: How do bacterial polyphosphate granules relate to acidocalcisome-like membrane structures?
gap-42d2b63261b5bc9f2f075d24311ce577b2f2.rationale: Seufferheld et al. 2003 reported membrane-bounded, acidic, polyphosphate- and cation-rich Agrobacterium granules using microscopy, localization and fractionation. Frank and Jendrossek 2020 instead separated polyphosphate granules from HppA-associated foci in C58 using fluorescence and mutants; they did not perform TEM. Docampo 2024 counters that growth phase, fluorescent tags and detection of short polyphosphate chains limit the contrary interpretation. The disagreement remains unresolved and does not justify declaring bacterial acidocalcisomes absent or all bacterial polyphosphate granules equivalent to this organelle. Original 2003 strain context still requires direct verification.

gap-455b5601548b435c3c4ca173f71a69d79fe9.prompt: Distinguish the Spg1 GTPase from its GAP and bound interphase/checkpoint inhibition by cell-cycle context.
gap-455b5601548b435c3c4ca173f71a69d79fe9.rationale: The inherited GO:0160066 definition calls Spg1 a GTPase activator, although the cited primary paper identifies Spg1 as the GTPase inhibited by Byr4-Cdc16. Earlier curation corrected part of the function wording but left the definition and an unrestricted inactive-before-anaphase claim. The paper separates normal cell-cycle progression from G2 and mitotic checkpoint arrests.
gap-455b5601548b435c3c4ca173f71a69d79fe9.resolution_note: Use a literature-backed local definition and inhibitory function. Spg1 can activate in metaphase; Dma1-dependent Sid4 ubiquitination limits Plo1 recruitment in G2 and checkpoint arrest, rather than proving global SIN inactivity before anaphase. This clarification supersedes the erroneous role and unrestricted inhibition interpretation while preserving prior discussions, the old-SPB interphase association, GO identity and open component-grounding task.

gap-4d7c3d459ddcc9e6b6b45a32b742a55f57e6.resolution_note: Curated GO:0005824 as the general SPB outer plaque, linked it by parthood to GO:0005816, and left the sporulation-specific meiotic outer-plaque boundary for a focused component-level curation pass.

gap-4d97cbcac21589f636c25808bfd82242b703.prompt: Resolve which linker-specific interactions control ciliary protein entry or retention.
gap-4d97cbcac21589f636c25808bfd82242b703.rationale: CEP290 loss changes ciliary protein composition, but it also disrupts multiple connector features. Those phenotypes do not isolate the Y-link contribution or demonstrate a particular binding or transport reaction.

gap-4de030cd466502ec1eef1185dfdf9f7b9960.prompt: Should Sec61-channel subunits or Kar2/BiP be included as Sec62/Sec63 complex components?
gap-4de030cd466502ec1eef1185dfdf9f7b9960.rationale: GO:0031207 denotes the Sec62p/Sec63p/Sec71p/Sec72p subcomplex. The Sec61 heterotrimer combines with it in the broader ER Sec complex, and Kar2/BiP powers posttranslational import from the lumen, but neither is part of the Sec62/Sec63 tetramer.
gap-4de030cd466502ec1eef1185dfdf9f7b9960.resolution_note: Modeled Sec62p, Sec63p, Sec71p, and Sec72p as constituents and left Sec61-channel subunits and Kar2/BiP outside this subcomplex record.

gap-4df912210421ad58db0ea52447c305db31f8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for microneme adhesins and the MIC2-M2AP adhesive protein complex.
gap-4df912210421ad58db0ea52447c305db31f8.rationale: The first record uses microneme-localized adhesive protein cohorts because the cited proteins span multiple unrelated adhesin families and no exact cross-source complex CURIE was curated for MIC2-M2AP.

gap-4e09f914a7facca184ab90909055e0d04e85.prompt: Keep ESCRT complexes and cargo-recognition factors out of the multivesicular-body intraluminal vesicle component list.
gap-4e09f914a7facca184ab90909055e0d04e85.rationale: ESCRT machinery sorts cargo and drives limiting-membrane remodeling during intraluminal-vesicle formation, but it is modeled as assembly machinery rather than as a stable molecular constituent of the resulting vesicle.
gap-4e09f914a7facca184ab90909055e0d04e85.resolution_note: Curated ESCRT-III as an assembly graph node and excluded ESCRT machinery from the component list.

gap-4e3348283758c3f835c1657ad427636ab7dd.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the trans-Golgi network membrane.
gap-4e3348283758c3f835c1657ad427636ab7dd.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0032588, but the TGN membrane lipid-bilayer constituent is intentionally left as reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-4e65493e0ffc3433d956e0319711768c1421.prompt: Reassess 2026 regulatory and adaptive-function models when full primary evidence and final versions are available.
gap-4e65493e0ffc3433d956e0319711768c1421.rationale: Two relevant 2026 bioRxiv studies have eLife reviewed-preprint versions; neither is treated here as a version of record or proof of MDC-specific fitness benefit.

gap-4e66c7254b3020de80dec0cc087723c4f888.prompt: Archaellins and prearchaellin maturation enzymes are out of scope for the motor record.
gap-4e66c7254b3020de80dec0cc087723c4f888.rationale: The archaellum motor is the basal ATP-powered machine. Archaellins are the polymerized filament subunits, and PibD/FlaK-like prepilin peptidases act on archaellin precursors before filament assembly rather than forming part of the basal motor.

gap-4e964e80dd462710fc266640e78a3437a497.prompt: Are PFR-AF1 and PFR-AF2 paraflagellar-rod components?
gap-4e964e80dd462710fc266640e78a3437a497.rationale: PFR-AF1 and PFR-AF2 are cytoplasmic proteins required for PFR formation, but the component boundary in docs/CURATION.md excludes factors that act on a subunit before assembly and then depart.
gap-4e964e80dd462710fc266640e78a3437a497.resolution_note: Curated PFR-AF1 and PFR-AF2 as assembly graph nodes rather than as components of the mature paraflagellar rod.

gap-4ea136ec9e58d090214616a6a2537ecf5e85.prompt: Keep the mitotic SPB intermediate layer narrower than the general SPB intermediate layer.
gap-4ea136ec9e58d090214616a6a2537ecf5e85.rationale: GO:0061498 denotes the intermediate layer of the mitotic spindle pole body, is narrower than GO:0005821, and is part of the GO:0044732 mitotic spindle pole body.

gap-4ea136ec9e58d090214616a6a2537ecf5e85.resolution_note: Curated GO:0061498 as the mitosis-specific SPB intermediate layer, with is-a and part-of links to the corresponding GO terms.

gap-4ea98a030a867864bef3c4757cf362137b00.prompt: Obtain experimentally resolved imaging of the assembled Cullin-E complex.
gap-4ea98a030a867864bef3c4757cf362137b00.rationale: Phenotype images and generic or predicted models do not locate or resolve this assembly.

gap-4ebef4de77132855b1425e31ef7d5c2f95e5.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the curated TFIIK protein constituents.
gap-4ebef4de77132855b1425e31ef7d5c2f95e5.rationale: GO:0070985 defines Saccharomyces and human names for three TFIIK complex subunits. Exact cross-eukaryotic InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or UniProt family boundaries for these TFIIK classes need narrower curation before the component labels can be grounded.

gap-4ecf800629037dae1edd91fc23628215ac63.prompt: Do not model Vps1 as a constituent component of yeast ESCRT-0.
gap-4ecf800629037dae1edd91fc23628215ac63.rationale: The GO:0033565 definition text currently names Vps1p, but its exact Vps27p-Hse1p synonym and Bilodeau et al. 2002 identify Vps27p with Hse1p as the yeast ESCRT-0 complex curated here.

gap-4efb9662534806ee9f27f084902fb2800fa3.prompt: Identify native microbial CID constituents and test CID-specific biological roles.
gap-4efb9662534806ee9f27f084902fb2800fa3.rationale: Morphological contacts and structural models do not demonstrate a protein identity, necessity, or causal mechanism.

gap-4efc2aad72a6020c83ac2159a17a4ba2df94.prompt: Keep SurA and other soluble periplasmic chaperones out of the Bam protein complex component list.
gap-4efc2aad72a6020c83ac2159a17a4ba2df94.rationale: Hagan, Kim and Kahne 2010 required a soluble chaperone in the reconstituted OMP assembly assay, but that chaperone acts on the substrate before BAM-mediated membrane insertion and is not a constituent of the BamABCDE complex.

gap-4f0302143c7e8fa011f0a657642f6631d2e8.prompt: Resolve source-neutral component boundaries across RNase P complex lineages.
gap-4f0302143c7e8fa011f0a657642f6631d2e8.rationale: GO:0030677 captures the shared RNase P ribonucleoprotein identity and pre-tRNA 5-prime leader cleavage function, while its term comment flags that chloroplast complexes called RNase P appear not to contain RNA. Exact RNA and protein components should be curated on source-specific dimeric, multimeric, nucleolar, cyanelle and mitochondrial children before assigning source-neutral constituents to this generic parent; chloroplast or other RNA-free RNase P-like complexes need separate protein-only modeling instead of inheriting a generic RNase P RNA component.

gap-4f0f3863d0d68a96f308eaa377f18f305444.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral boundaries and groundings for chromatin, nucleolar RNP, and nuclear-envelope-associated protein cohorts in the nucleus.
gap-4f0f3863d0d68a96f308eaa377f18f305444.rationale: This first nucleus record grounds the nuclear pore as an exact protein-complex component but avoids treating chromatin or nucleolar cohorts as a single exact protein, RNA, or DNA component.

gap-4f6382eaad0848f2b20ec28802d43b8a9573.prompt: Resolve exact TssB/VipA, TssC/VipB and ClpV/TssH family groundings from InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or another source-neutral protein-family authority.
gap-4f6382eaad0848f2b20ec28802d43b8a9573.rationale: The literature identifies these sheath and recycling proteins, but this curation pass did not verify exact family-level CURIEs for the taxon-agnostic component rows.

gap-4f8d7e4fdfb1561b691989e98a7e69abfbdb.prompt: Should adjacent proteins, genetic regulators and all proteomics hits be listed as constituents?
gap-4f8d7e4fdfb1561b691989e98a7e69abfbdb.rationale: The 2017 workflow distinguishes 156 candidate hits from microscopy-supported localization.

Snf1 loss affects formation but does not establish Snf1 residence. Snf1-dependent Pfk2 phosphorylation is dispensable in the tested phosphosite mutants. gap-4fb5c1235d7ae1692dbe9404081843c0e7b7.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral DnaE, DnaQ and HolE family groundings for DNA polymerase III core components.
gap-4fb5c1235d7ae1692dbe9404081843c0e7b7.rationale: This first GO:0044776 split captures the E. coli alpha, epsilon and theta subunits named by GO and Maki/Kornberg while leaving exact source-neutral protein-family grounding and gram-positive PolC-versus-DnaE boundaries to a later pass.

gap-4fe8d141a412daf920f163ef0832339cf110.prompt: Keep the radial spoke head distinct from the whole radial spoke and adjacent neck and stalk subcomplexes.
gap-4fe8d141a412daf920f163ef0832339cf110.rationale: GO:0001535 denotes the terminal protein-complex portion of the radial spoke that projects toward the central pair, GO:0001534 denotes the complete radial spoke, GO:0120343 denotes the radial spoke neck, and GO:0001536 denotes the radial spoke stalk.
gap-4fe8d141a412daf920f163ef0832339cf110.resolution_note: Curated GO:0001535 as the exact head subcomplex and used GO:0001534 for whole-radial-spoke parthood.

gap-5049bf49778caddf1a03482045a72ccd5cbe.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam or NCBIfam grounding for the cryptophyte 6-kDa ejectisin polypeptides.
gap-5049bf49778caddf1a03482045a72ccd5cbe.rationale: Ejectisins were identified as major cryptophycean ejectisome components, but this pass did not verify a curated family accession that exactly denotes those small structural polypeptides.

gap-505903bd263488bc433032efab2a066417c3.prompt: Establish intact adaptor-bearing architecture and physiological substrate range with direct structural and condition-matched evidence.
gap-505903bd263488bc433032efab2a066417c3.rationale: Native-gel migration and trapped photo-crosslinks do not determine stoichiometry or visualize substrate movement. Tagged substrates turn over faster than endogenous proteins, and temperature/media matter. The linked biochemical figure is not a micrograph of the complex. Earlier adaptor papers and the separate Yme1 core structural study require full-text review before extending this record.

gap-508a23c885caf2b657e478ec68cb0ac5401e.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for mitotic spindle motors and microtubule-associated proteins.
gap-508a23c885caf2b657e478ec68cb0ac5401e.rationale: GO defines spindles as microtubules plus associated molecules; this first record captures the alpha/beta-tubulin polymer boundary and defers the taxon-specific motor and microtubule-associated protein set.

gap-50bb75cf517599b95bc4ae8efa1eee07f56c.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings and species boundaries for meiotic septin-complex septin proteins.
gap-50bb75cf517599b95bc4ae8efa1eee07f56c.rationale: The initial meiotic septin complex record uses a reviewed-label-only septin protein cohort rather than guessing a family CURIE or importing species-specific paralogs into the generic GO:0032152 record.

gap-50fc5b0024cd6cadaf6793a9f81a78780e37.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings, record boundaries and copy numbers for C1a/C1b/C1c/C1d/C1e/C1f and C2a/C2b/C2c/C2d/C2e axonemal central pair projection subcomplexes.
gap-50fc5b0024cd6cadaf6793a9f81a78780e37.rationale: Carbajal-Gonzalez et al. 2013 resolved named C1 and C2 projection densities, but this pass only curates the broad GO:1990718 projection class and leaves exact named projection subcomplexes and their protein-family groundings unresolved.

gap-510398cef4ab2b7d5f9e2cad4144136d90c4.prompt: Model the core primosome separately from the broader primosome, primase-lacking pre-primosomes and the protein-only DnaB-DnaG complex.
gap-510398cef4ab2b7d5f9e2cad4144136d90c4.rationale: GO:1990098 denotes a DNA-bound helicase-primase core, GO:1990077 denotes the broader primosome class, GO:1990099 denotes primase-lacking pre-primosomes, and species-specific helicase-primase protein subcomplexes such as GO:1990156 are narrower parts of particular core primosomes rather than generic GO:1990098 has_part structures.
gap-510398cef4ab2b7d5f9e2cad4144136d90c4.resolution_note: Curated GO:1990077 as the is-a parent and kept DnaB-DnaG, DnaC and pre-primosome accessory proteins out of this generic core-primosome record.

gap-5194e4e00a67d2b0eb1505c819a43ea706fe.prompt: Resolve remaining nuclear-lumen bodies and substructures before expanding the component list.
gap-5194e4e00a67d2b0eb1505c819a43ea706fe.rationale: This first nuclear-lumen record grounds the nuclear chromosome and nucleolus because existing CellStructureMech records already curate their GO boundaries, but GO:0031981 can contain additional nuclear bodies and subregions whose exact GO and literature boundaries need separate review.

gap-519de0964206bd7e102a37915f30c06172a6.prompt: Keep the endocytic-vesicle clathrin coat distinct from the broader clathrin vesicle coat record.
gap-519de0964206bd7e102a37915f30c06172a6.rationale: GO:0030128 is the clathrin coat subtype on endocytic vesicles, while GO:0030125 is the broader clathrin vesicle coat parent that also covers TGN and synaptic vesicle subtypes.
gap-519de0964206bd7e102a37915f30c06172a6.resolution_note: Represented GO:0030128 as a child of GO:0030125 and as part of the GO:0030669 endocytic vesicle membrane rather than duplicating the broad clathrin vesicle coat record.

gap-51be0df9b8cd382c9345e550b0f8a2ec804e.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro or Pfam groundings for the Vps4 AAA ATPase and Vta1 cofactor component classes.
gap-51be0df9b8cd382c9345e550b0f8a2ec804e.rationale: This first ESCRT IV complex record records the named budding-yeast Vps4 and Vta1 proteins without asserting paralogy boundaries or family accessions that have not been reviewed exactly.

gap-521291d876161e4f6aa001ba0c7ff50b089d.prompt: Keep coatomer and Arf-family GTPases on the COPI vesicle coat record rather than duplicating them as direct COPI-coated vesicle components.
gap-521291d876161e4f6aa001ba0c7ff50b089d.rationale: The whole-vesicle record uses GO:0030126 for its COPI coat part, and the coat record already models coatomer and Arf as COPI coat constituents. Repeating those subunits here would flatten the coat-versus-vesicle partonomy.
gap-521291d876161e4f6aa001ba0c7ff50b089d.resolution_note: Added the COPI coat and COPI-coated vesicle membrane as vesicle parts and left lower-level coat subunits to the GO:0030126 COPI vesicle coat record.

gap-5232900dce2a90d8d89db8c77fac4ad1e16a.prompt: Keep the DnaA-Dps complex distinct from DnaA/Hda RIDA complexes.
gap-5232900dce2a90d8d89db8c77fac4ad1e16a.rationale: GO:1990084 denotes DnaA bound to Dps, whereas GO:1990083 denotes the DnaA-Hda complex and GO:1990085 denotes Hda bound to the DnaN beta clamp.
gap-5232900dce2a90d8d89db8c77fac4ad1e16a.resolution_note: Curated only DnaA and Dps on GO:1990084 and left Hda, the beta clamp, and RIDA hydrolysis chemistry out of the component list and graph edges.

gap-52c49bce8d62ea9acc6a9fc4e0c300a24732.prompt: Should the taurine dioxygenase complex assert one fixed dimer or tetramer stoichiometry?
gap-52c49bce8d62ea9acc6a9fc4e0c300a24732.rationale: No. GO:1990205 defines E. coli TauD as a homodimer or homotetramer, while PDB:1OS7 contains separate homodimeric biological assemblies. This record cites the PDB-specific dimer measurement but leaves the class-level TauD homo-oligomer boundary flexible.

aliases: flagellin-based flagellum basal body, distal rod
gap-52d075275c0ad27f2f0aeb3e044df434d194.prompt: Should L/P rings, the hook, or rod assembly factors be curated as bacterial-type flagellum distal-rod components?
gap-52d075275c0ad27f2f0aeb3e044df434d194.rationale: The mature GO:0009426 distal rod is scoped to the FlgG axial polymer even though the GO L- and P-ring terms sit under the distal rod. The L and P rings surround the distal rod as Gram-negative bushings, the hook continues the external axial structure, and export or capping proteins act during assembly rather than remaining mature distal-rod subunits.
gap-52d075275c0ad27f2f0aeb3e044df434d194.record_label: bacterial-type flagellum basal body, distal rod
gap-52d075275c0ad27f2f0aeb3e044df434d194.resolution_note: Declined: keep FlgG as the only mature distal-rod constituent and represent L/P rings, hooks, and export or capping proteins on their own records or on the enclosing basal-body record.

gap-52e4831d92053c1ab9024ae79bdd270f41a3.prompt: Do partial localizers establish a fixed actin-body composition?
gap-52e4831d92053c1ab9024ae79bdd270f41a3.rationale: Membership strength differs between proteins and organisms; co-occurrence is not a stoichiometric reconstruction. Sac6 loss is pleiotropic. Scp1 perturbation does not establish Scp1 residence, and fission-yeast polarity proteins lost from cell tips are not thereby body constituents.
gap-52e4831d92053c1ab9024ae79bdd270f41a3.resolution_note: Retain the directly observed partial localizers with explicit scope; omit whole Arp2/3-complex stoichiometry and essentiality claims. Do not add Scp1, Tea1, Exo70 or Sec8 as body components from the cited perturbation/polarity results.

gap-530956ac15c140a5e69d511d57c7e3312ae1.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the generic lipid constituent of the glycosome membrane.
gap-530956ac15c140a5e69d511d57c7e3312ae1.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0046860, but no glycosome-specific lipid or lipid-bilayer CURIE was curated for the membrane constituent.

gap-533a0cc5691a0fc93c796f24cc1c92da7419.prompt: Curate axonemal doublets, basal-body triplets, haptonemal singlets and other array-specific microtubule subtypes as exact subtypes or array-specific components before mapping them back to GO:0005874.
gap-533a0cc5691a0fc93c796f24cc1c92da7419.rationale: Microbial eukaryotes build specialized microtubule arrays; this generic record records only the shared GO:0005874 polymer boundary and does not flatten doublet, triplet, singlet or ventral-disc-specific morphologies into one component.

gap-5387b7b4c5eb2d251d922a403124ee93f6b5.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein-family groundings for Nup84/Y-complex outer-ring nucleoporin classes.
gap-5387b7b4c5eb2d251d922a403124ee93f6b5.rationale: Nup84/Y-complex members have several paralog and ortholog names across fungi and vertebrates; this first record avoids guessing one exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or UniProtKB accession for each source-neutral component class.

gap-53ab026559d7fe27bea76ce58debd01b6efc.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for the Saccharomyces Fks1/Fks2 catalytic pair and the Rho1 regulatory subunit.
gap-53ab026559d7fe27bea76ce58debd01b6efc.rationale: The initial record follows experimentally named Saccharomyces proteins and avoids guessing InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or UniProtKB accessions that would broaden component identities beyond the curated Fks1/Fks2 and Rho1 boundary.

gap-54136e7d75a857e3e128054a3ed3202bd85c.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the PilA major pilin.
gap-54136e7d75a857e3e128054a3ed3202bd85c.rationale: The record intentionally uses a reviewed label until an exact InterPro, Pfam or NCBIfam identifier for Caulobacter PilA-family Tad pilins can be verified.

gap-543d021084ef431507bd72076591ed3cb789.prompt: Avoid modeling every AP-3 adaptor complex as a clathrin-coat constituent.
gap-543d021084ef431507bd72076591ed3cb789.rationale: The GO:0030123 definition explicitly notes that AP-3 does not appear to associate with clathrin in all organisms. This record therefore keeps the parent-level membrane-coat adaptor identity through GO:0030119 but avoids a universal AP-3 to clathrin edge.

gap-5468e57424e8a8ce1c75d4fae5c5964fa286.prompt: Resolve exact InterPro, Pfam or NCBIfam grounding for microbial eukaryotic SF-assemblin homologs that build striated ciliary rootlets.
gap-5468e57424e8a8ce1c75d4fae5c5964fa286.rationale: SF-assemblin homologs are established constituents of green-algal and ciliate striated rootlets, but this pass did not verify one family accession that exactly covers those rootlet proteins without pulling in unrelated coiled-coil proteins.

gap-54ebf7216b6206df8b742e7baba1f07d23a8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral non-U5 snRNP membership, excised-intron RNA and additional protein boundaries for each post-mRNA release spliceosomal complex subtype.
gap-54ebf7216b6206df8b742e7baba1f07d23a8.rationale: The GO:0071014 parent record captures the generic presence of a conserved U5 snRNP, two non-U5 snRNPs whose exact identities depend on the U2-type or U12-type spliceosome subtype and the excised intron that remains after spliced-product release. Child records for U2-type and U12-type post-mRNA release spliceosomal complexes carry the exact U2/U6 and U12/U6atac partner-snRNP boundaries that apply to those specific states, while exact protein-family and excised-intron RNA boundaries remain to be curated.

gap-5508c3be5b65a8febb2dc27ffb2466601f41.prompt: Model the shared ancestry of the injectisome export apparatus and the flagellar fT3SS explicitly.

gap-5caf3b47827072504a9bbe97cadb05040f56.rationale: Confocal correspondence alone does not resolve the molecular composition of individual membrane strands.

gap-5d168b0c2d62f48aec071f514a26220aae64.prompt: Do not model Nhp6 as a core FACT complex constituent.
gap-5d168b0c2d62f48aec071f514a26220aae64.rationale: Formosa et al. 2001 reported that Spt16/Cdc68 and Pob3 form a yeast heterodimer and that this heterodimer combines with Nhp6 to form the nucleosome-binding factor SPN, supporting Nhp6 as a DNA-binding cofactor for the yeast SPN activity rather than one of the two FACT core constituents.
gap-5d168b0c2d62f48aec071f514a26220aae64.resolution_note: Declined: Nhp6 is important for the yeast SPN nucleosome-binding factor, but this record curates the FACT core as the Spt16-Pob3 complex.

gap-5d19825b92758bc8409a3b2bcd3e769f7fb0.prompt: Decide whether GO:0062155 curli secretion complex needs its own CellStructureMech record.
gap-5d19825b92758bc8409a3b2bcd3e769f7fb0.rationale: GO has an exact curli secretion complex term for the Csg secretion machinery. This curli record models that secretion route only in the assembly graph because it exports fiber subunits but is not itself part of the amyloid pilus.
gap-5d19825b92758bc8409a3b2bcd3e769f7fb0.resolution_note: Added GO:0062155 as a standalone curli secretion complex record and kept it separate from the GO:0098774 curli appendage because the Csg secretion machinery exports curli subunits but is not part of the extracellular amyloid fiber.

gap-5df9e9e7762cecca321091dcaef0d886384f.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral DiaA, DnaA and oriC origin DNA groundings for the DnaA-DiaA complex.
gap-5df9e9e7762cecca321091dcaef0d886384f.rationale: GO:1990102 defines the DnaA-DiaA complex around a DiaA tetramer attached to DnaA molecules bound to oriC DNA. Exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, UniProt family or SO sequence-feature CURIEs for these primitive components need narrower curation before the labels can be grounded.

gap-5e0affc839d4bc3b1b82eb684314971619a2.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identities for the label-only component classes.
gap-5e0affc839d4bc3b1b82eb684314971619a2.rationale: Heterogeneous membrane/cytosolic material has no single molecular identity; the inspected Tom71 and Dnm1 matches do not support exact family groundings.

gap-5e22d2c40404b3996279a9b63d7222cb6330.prompt: Separate observed cargo and release machinery from upstream regulators.
gap-5e22d2c40404b3996279a9b63d7222cb6330.rationale: Colocalization, genetic dependency, and membership in the compartment are different observations.
gap-5e22d2c40404b3996279a9b63d7222cb6330.resolution_note: Include membrane material, sampled Tom70/Tom71 cargo and variably enclosed cytosol as constituents, with Dnm1 as associated release machinery. Mcp1, Scm4, Msp1 and Fzo1 are additional reported cargo or associated proteins, not excluded by absence evidence and not asserted to be invariant. ERMES, Gem1, Atg5, lipid enzymes, Yme1, Ups proteins, MICOS, Snf1 and Mig1 are not made canonical MDC constituents solely from perturbations. No fixed stoichiometry is assigned.

gap-5e27f9ec9a039939113b2d850dadb845c774.prompt: Should membrane-bound ribosomes or the SRP receptor beta subunit be included as Ssh1 translocon complex components?
gap-5e27f9ec9a039939113b2d850dadb845c774.rationale: Membrane-bound ribosomes and the SRP receptor contact Ssh1 during cotranslational ER import, but the directly curated core is the Ssh1p/Sbh2p/Sss1p trimer.
gap-5e27f9ec9a039939113b2d850dadb845c774.resolution_note: Modeled Ssh1p, Sbh2p, and Sss1p as Ssh1 translocon constituents and left ribosomes and the SRP receptor outside the core complex.

gap-5e452ab6ce405ed0bf538fdda2436603c45d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral grounding for Hsp78-type chaperones and the heterogeneous aggregate cargo where an appropriate authority supports it.
gap-5e452ab6ce405ed0bf538fdda2436603c45d.rationale: The inspected Hsp78 InterPro matches are broader than the component; the cargo is not one protein family. Exact matches should not be fabricated.

aliases: trans-Golgi network constitutive secretory pathway transport vesicle membrane
gap-5e4ed8a66ac15262b624f8ca023999e98baf.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the trans-Golgi network transport vesicle membrane.
gap-5e4ed8a66ac15262b624f8ca023999e98baf.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0012510, but the TGN transport vesicle membrane lipid-bilayer constituent is intentionally left reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-5e4f2a1d32023c23a652313d133f20f89b0a.prompt: Keep the whole meiotic array distinct from its organizer, constituent filaments and neighboring structures.
gap-5e4f2a1d32023c23a652313d133f20f89b0a.rationale: Parsed checks over 907 records and whole-repository searches including ignored and hidden files found only prior read-ahead notes, not an existing HAA record. GO:0032117 is exact; GO:0005818 is its native is-a parent and GO:0030981 its native part-of target. No extra HAA part-of meiotic-spindle claim is inferred from ancestor relations. OTHER denotes a multi-filament system, not one microtubule, the nuclear-movement process, the telomere bouquet, the SPB or the rMTOC. Native GO wording that microtubules emanate from the SPB is retained, while the 2012 ultrastructure resolves their organization near but distinct from the SPB core.

gap-5e6f910ccf24685e86f2a386cd3922248995.prompt: Keep the radial spoke neck distinct from the whole radial spoke and adjacent head and stalk subcomplexes.
gap-5e6f910ccf24685e86f2a386cd3922248995.rationale: GO:0120343 denotes the connector subcomplex between the radial-spoke stalk and head, GO:0001534 denotes the complete radial spoke, GO:0001535 denotes the radial spoke head, and GO:0001536 denotes the radial spoke stalk.
gap-5e6f910ccf24685e86f2a386cd3922248995.resolution_note: Curated GO:0120343 as the exact neck subcomplex and used GO:0001534 for whole-radial-spoke parthood.

gap-5e78da74319cb29c4c06c2e7c5ded2f501a0.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for SPB satellite constituents.
gap-5e78da74319cb29c4c06c2e7c5ded2f501a0.rationale: The first SPB satellite record captures the transient precursor without guessing exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or Complex Portal groundings for budding-yeast satellite constituents.

gap-5ec4722edd28755e293ba6f43b9d44f725b6.prompt: Split the VgrG/PAAR spike into a separate CellStructureRecord if its assembly mechanism needs an independent causal graph.
gap-5ec4722edd28755e293ba6f43b9d44f725b6.rationale: The VgrG/PAAR spike now has a dedicated CellStructureRecord alongside the T6SS membrane core, baseplate, Hcp tube, and contractile sheath subassembly records.
gap-5ec4722edd28755e293ba6f43b9d44f725b6.record_label: type VI protein secretion system complex
gap-5ec4722edd28755e293ba6f43b9d44f725b6.resolution_note: Added cellstructuremech:type_vi_secretion_system_vgrg_paar_spike_complex for the VgrG/PAAR tip complex and grounded the whole-system spike component to it.

gap-5f42871dc68c0e6a2db6e31d01003d0479a1.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings and boundary status for bud-neck septin-ring septins and septin-associated proteins.
gap-5f42871dc68c0e6a2db6e31d01003d0479a1.rationale: The first localized bud-neck septin-ring record keeps only the reviewed-label-only septin protein cohort rather than guessing InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam accessions and rather than adding the GO-defined septin-associated proteins before their exact constituent boundary has been reviewed.

gap-5f50e1012976da2f90d341291826a9c468cf.prompt: Review whether the GO:0120115 Lsm2-8 complex should be split into individual Lsm family components, and resolve exact source-neutral groundings for U6atac-specific protein families that form the U6atac snRNP.
gap-5f50e1012976da2f90d341291826a9c468cf.rationale: The first GO:0005691 record captures U6atac snRNA and the GO-defined Lsm2-8 complex at coarse granularity. GO:0120115 already grounds the Lsm2-8 complex, so follow-up curation should decide whether the Lsm2-8 ring should remain one complex component or be split into individual Lsm-family components and should resolve U6atac-specific protein-family boundaries before splitting that protein inventory.

gap-5f5a29b27f3ba7da83ddff338e032abcfca3.prompt: Should all proteomic PFR candidates be curated as paraflagellar-rod components now?
gap-5f5a29b27f3ba7da83ddff338e032abcfca3.rationale: The PFR proteome contains many low-abundance or regulatory proteins in addition to the two major lattice proteins; Portman et al. 2009 identified 20 novel PFR components by RNAi-ablation proteomics and epitope tagging. This first GO:0097740 record therefore enumerates only PFR1/PFR2, while additional candidates need family-by-family curation to avoid folding transient or nearby flagellar proteins into the structural lattice boundary.

gap-5f80483f90e43a10544b8d9b97b8bc817ed7.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for the polar tube anchoring disc.
gap-5f80483f90e43a10544b8d9b97b8bc817ed7.rationale: EnP1 is experimentally localized to the polar sac/anchoring disk region, but the full molecular composition of the anchoring disc and polar sac remains incompletely resolved in this record.

gap-5f85a4c36d06544bb710c7ba297e4d6733f5.prompt: TubR and tubC centromere DNA are graph-scoped partition adapters rather than TubZ filament constituents.
gap-5f85a4c36d06544bb710c7ba297e4d6733f5.rationale: TubR bound to the pBtoxis tubC centromere site engages TubZ filaments in the TubZRC partition system, but this centromeric complex is cargo-coupling machinery rather than a TubZ polymer subunit.

gap-5fc364163e159eb6f7700f66ce4dc506e0c7.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for LH2 and F0F1-ATP synthase complexes in purple-bacterial chromatophore membranes.
gap-5fc364163e159eb6f7700f66ce4dc506e0c7.rationale: LH2 antennae and F0F1-ATP synthase are supported as chromatophore constituents, but remain label-only components until exact source-neutral complex accessions are curated or minted.

gap-5fcf2e9fe347f3e1f0ef403e88073eb78a90.prompt: Resolve exact InterPro or Pfam accessions for rod phycobiliprotein, allophycocyanin, linker and phycobilin biosynthetic classes, or split these grouped components where exact family terms exist.
gap-5fcf2e9fe347f3e1f0ef403e88073eb78a90.rationale: The first phycobilisome record avoids broad phycobiliprotein groundings that could blur rods, core subunits and specialized terminal emitters.

gap-600be99792c4062318369cef96a4dac1e8d6.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Ndc80, Nuf2, Spc24 and Spc25 subunits.
gap-600be99792c4062318369cef96a4dac1e8d6.rationale: The GO complex term spans orthologous Ndc80-family complexes across eukaryotes, and no exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProtKB family CURIE was verified for these subunit families in this pass.

gap-60834ce42bd727dbb4a5b88473af187367a6.prompt: Resolve stabilization without upgrading models into measured mechanisms.
gap-60834ce42bd727dbb4a5b88473af187367a6.rationale: Nocodazole resistance, low tubulin turnover and stability after laser severing bound stability to these assays. A GTP cap inferred from Bim1 binding is not directly measured, and microtubule crosslinking mechanisms remain models. Survival/regrowth effects are supported but perturbations also act beyond this array. Proposed tubulin storage, a molecular SPB-separation checkpoint and homology with primary cilia are not asserted as demonstrated functions.

gap-60cfa67750630b15fecde82f0f2d6ba40c8c.prompt: Resolve exact ESX-3-specific EccB3, EccC3, EccD3, and EccE3 protein-family groundings.
gap-60cfa67750630b15fecde82f0f2d6ba40c8c.rationale: The reviewed M. smegmatis MC2 155 UniProt entries map to broad EccB, EccC, EccD, and EccE type VII secretion signatures, but no exact ESX-3-specific family CURIE was verified in this pass.
gap-60cfa67750630b15fecde82f0f2d6ba40c8c.record_label: ESX-3 type VII secretion system membrane complex

gap-60ec0249146497b56f90bfd6f634f6560937.prompt: Require localization before promoting whole-cell proteomics hits to components.
gap-60ec0249146497b56f90bfd6f634f6560937.rationale: Differential abundance in whole cells does not establish tentacle membership.

gap-60ed5dd1f3cf0d3682064af2446e81e184ed.prompt: Keep the capsule record restricted to organized, surface-retained capsules rather than loose slime layers.
gap-60ed5dd1f3cf0d3682064af2446e81e184ed.rationale: GO:0042603 denotes the organized capsule subclass of glycocalyx. A diffuse released exopolysaccharide slime layer would need a separate record if curated.

gap-611d5bb1d624d8611c5d7c7a79c95ae66aaf.prompt: Resolve localization and architecture of the assembled CRL4WDR1 particle.
gap-611d5bb1d624d8611c5d7c7a79c95ae66aaf.rationale: Subunit immunofluorescence does not demonstrate colocalization of all constituents.

aliases: endosomal sorting complex required for transport
gap-612929d90a62e8b86f146d375d53b202fec6.prompt: Review and curate the one Vps22, two Vps25 and one Vps36 heterotetrameric ESCRT-II stoichiometry.
gap-612929d90a62e8b86f146d375d53b202fec6.rationale: Hierro et al. 2004 resolved the yeast ESCRT-II structural architecture as a Y-shaped heterotetramer. This first ESCRT-II record leaves per-component stoichiometry blank until the exact copy numbers and family-level component boundaries are reviewed together.

gap-6134997634968fda007fdd46928962426e00.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the plastid outer membrane.
gap-6134997634968fda007fdd46928962426e00.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0009527 and UniProt SL-0214, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-617dd6cb16a4ce1fb77eb99fecfd3cdccedc.prompt: Separate directly localized proteins from regulators, reporters and partially colocalizing complexes.
gap-617dd6cb16a4ce1fb77eb99fecfd3cdccedc.rationale: Genetic dependence, fluorescence overlap and biochemical interaction do not establish fixed composition or universal assembly requirements.

gap-61a3da76cc6fcca5056476d6fb9e34bb607f.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries for U12-type prespliceosome proteins beyond the GO-defined U11/U12 snRNP subcomplex.
gap-61a3da76cc6fcca5056476d6fb9e34bb607f.rationale: The first GO:0071015 record captures the defining U11/U12 snRNP subcomplex. Additional U12-type prespliceosome proteins should be resolved into exact source-neutral families or subcomplexes before expanding the component list.

gap-61c1b5b4683ef66cb7d70d36a8051dcda5e6.prompt: Keep localization dependencies and candidate connectors separate from established constituents.
gap-61c1b5b4683ef66cb7d70d36a8051dcda5e6.rationale: An upstream recruitment factor, downstream signal or neighboring marker is not automatically part of a complex.

gap-61dead22bd02f4d7c90df9bbe6141346e674.prompt: Does MIB duplicate MICOS, SAM or MIMAS?
gap-61dead22bd02f4d7c90df9bbe6141346e674.rationale: MIB denotes the larger bridging assembly; its existing MICOS and SAM records denote subcomplexes. The GO synonym mitofilin complex is retained without treating every mitofilin-containing assembly as MIB.
gap-61dead22bd02f4d7c90df9bbe6141346e674.resolution_note: Use GO:0140275 and explicit has_part relations, not a local identifier or equivalence to a constituent.

gap-62005207d9626eb69ce144a9b6da1f404cc6.prompt: Resolve exact family groundings for Woronin body Hex1, WSC, Leashin and Pex11 biogenesis or tethering factors.
gap-62005207d9626eb69ce144a9b6da1f404cc6.rationale: This first record curates Hex1 as the experimentally defined dense-core protein. WSC, Leashin and Pex11 participate in Woronin body biogenesis and positioning, but exact source-neutral family groundings and component boundaries should be resolved before adding them as components or associated machinery.

gap-62084bfe27c1f5a2c527d670744c98163113.prompt: Preserve experimental taxon and measurement scope.

gap-620e2200a97ceee615d2278c09816fc489e2.prompt: Should 19S, PAN, PA28, Mpa, Bpa, or Cpa families be listed as components of the generic proteasome accessory complex?
gap-620e2200a97ceee615d2278c09816fc489e2.rationale: GO:0022624 groups alternative proteasome caps and regulators. Those eukaryotic, archaeal, and actinobacterial accessory families do not share one curated source-neutral component set.
gap-620e2200a97ceee615d2278c09816fc489e2.resolution_note: Left molecular components unset on this generic cap record and reserved family-specific subunits for future records about exact accessory-family complexes.

gap-62179d2b5b352b79e1c34a098fab5948d564.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the mitosome outer membrane.
gap-62179d2b5b352b79e1c34a098fab5948d564.rationale: UniProt SL-0443 identifies the whole mitosome outer membrane, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-623b1f3fe6524ef1d321e3bba4cfb17214c3.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries for cytoplasmic exosome RNase complexes.
gap-623b1f3fe6524ef1d321e3bba4cfb17214c3.rationale: The first GO:0000177 record captures the GO-defined cytoplasmic exosome localization and RNA processing/decay activities. Exact source-neutral boundaries for the exosome core and catalytic nucleases should be curated from primary component evidence before assigning constituents.

gap-6240fb6e00aef663f20198db96e906513cac.prompt: Separate the nucleation-center core from upstream chromosome tethers and external motor systems.

gap-6273c67f90f6ccbaa097a32a7c29e023db84.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for hyphal-cap septin proteins.
gap-6273c67f90f6ccbaa097a32a7c29e023db84.rationale: The first hyphal septin-cap record uses a reviewed-label-only septin protein cohort rather than guessing InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam accessions that may not exactly delimit all septins in this apical hyphal cap.

gap-62f5c2a34db62bc8255f5dd137b79a3df81d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for SPB intermediate-layer constituents.
gap-62f5c2a34db62bc8255f5dd137b79a3df81d.rationale: The first GO-backed intermediate-layer record captures the named SPB layer without guessing exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or Complex Portal groundings for budding-yeast proteins in the layer.
gap-62f5c2a34db62bc8255f5dd137b79a3df81d.record_label: intermediate layer of spindle pole body

gap-6304553899dcb70b8aaa3fd7aae9a4c27002.prompt: Keep the continuous inner filament distinct from the cartwheel hub and discrete CID.
gap-6304553899dcb70b8aaa3fd7aae9a4c27002.rationale: A named morphological subassembly is not a single protein or an entire cartwheel.
gap-6304553899dcb70b8aaa3fd7aae9a4c27002.record_label: basal body filamentous cartwheel inner density

gap-6315ca0d1d56752477a45cf4ca20bf73ed9e.prompt: Should PaaD be modeled as a constituent of the phenylacetyl-CoA 1,2-epoxidase complex?
gap-6315ca0d1d56752477a45cf4ca20bf73ed9e.rationale: No. GO:0062077 uses the paaABCE complex synonym and QuickGO annotates PaaA, PaaB, PaaC and PaaE, but not PaaD, to the complex. Grishin et al. 2011 found that PaaD did not form a stable complex with the other proteins in the tested pull-downs and was not necessary for in vitro PaaABCE catalysis, while noting that it may assist maturation of the monooxygenase in vivo.

gap-6318a5fdf132e9a5dce190a941170c882663.prompt: Reconcile publication and archive detail differences before asserting exact substrate or construct boundaries.
gap-6318a5fdf132e9a5dce190a941170c882663.rationale: The article describes a nine-residue polyalanine substrate model, whereas the native PDB entity is a 12-residue unknown sequence. The paper reports approximately 3.21 angstrom resolution versus the archive's 3.3 angstrom. Methods begin the construct at Met182 while the figure schematic labels 181, and Figure 1's pore-loop residue notation is internally inconsistent.

gap-63324d673431bd33c792187f5b3164ae9ea7.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral snRNP membership for each U2-type spliceosomal state.
gap-63324d673431bd33c792187f5b3164ae9ea7.rationale: The first GO:0005684 parent record captures only the state-variable snRNP cohort supported by GO. Child records for the U2-type prespliceosome, precatalytic complex, catalytic complexes and post-spliceosomal states should carry the exact U1, U2, U4, U5 and U6 snRNP constituent boundaries that apply to those specific states.

gap-6346459cfcce2c2a290af0f2c900c8e7d95e.prompt: Keep cytoplasmic microtubules distinct from nuclear spindle microtubules while preserving GO axonemal microtubules as child structures.
gap-6346459cfcce2c2a290af0f2c900c8e7d95e.rationale: GO:0005881 denotes microtubules in the cytoplasm and therefore differs from the nuclear or spindle-anchored GO:0005876 spindle microtubule class. GO also places the axonemal microtubule class under cytoplasmic microtubule, so this record should stay broader than budding-yeast astral microtubules alone.
gap-6346459cfcce2c2a290af0f2c900c8e7d95e.resolution_note: Curated GO:0005881 as a GO-backed cytoplasmic microtubule subtype, parented it to GO:0005874, and used a budding-yeast SPB graph only as one concrete example of cytoplasmic microtubule organization.

gap-634a259ac177cf3a276505c007ea6eabb716.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings and exclusion evidence for fission-yeast SIN and NIMA-related proteins that distinguish the old mitotic SPB.
gap-634a259ac177cf3a276505c007ea6eabb716.rationale: This first GO-backed record captures the old mitotic SPB as an age/asymmetry structure without treating a lack of active fission-yeast-specific mitotic-exit proteins as positive component evidence or guessing InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, UniProtKB, or Complex Portal groundings.

gap-637143cf9348c869c416d8b3dc4bb764e3be.prompt: FtsZ division proteins are paralogous tubulin-family proteins rather than CetZ filament constituents.
gap-637143cf9348c869c416d8b3dc4bb764e3be.rationale: CetZ proteins coexist with FtsZ in many archaea and the Haloferax FtsZ1 division ring is distinct from the dynamic CetZ1 structures that control rod development.

gap-63a219cf9a75a97bd50fa7bd7e270a50a8f9.prompt: Resolve exact component-family mappings and studied-strain protein examples.
gap-63a219cf9a75a97bd50fa7bd7e270a50a8f9.rationale: Broad families and reference-genome annotations do not supply exact experimental examples.

gap-63b42ef683c73dc54144897febb7ad47fc15.prompt: Do not convert upstream factors, marker negatives or lifespan correlations into composition and universal function.
gap-63b42ef683c73dc54144897febb7ad47fc15.rationale: Localization, genetic dependence and pleiotropic phenotypes answer different questions.

gap-63f7fd8b94cf2ed30a5670da6d2a247edd2f.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and subtype boundaries for archaeal MCM, eukaryotic MCM2-7 and MCM8-MCM9 complex constituents.
gap-63f7fd8b94cf2ed30a5670da6d2a247edd2f.rationale: GO:0042555 exactly identifies the parent MCM complex and defines it as hexameric, while GO:0097362 identifies MCM8-MCM9 as a child of MCM. This record therefore models one generic hexamer-forming MCM subunit class instead of overclaiming six universal named subunits or collapsing MCM8-MCM9 into the parent complex.

gap-63f82c0e6ce21a41099ec3758982ce6a576b.prompt: Keep coatomer, Arf-family GTPases, and other subtype-specific coat proteins off the broad Golgi-associated vesicle record.
gap-63f82c0e6ce21a41099ec3758982ce6a576b.rationale: GO:0005798 is a broad Golgi-associated vesicle parent term, whereas GO:0030137 COPI-coated vesicles, GO:0030126 COPI vesicle coats, and other child or coat records carry exact coat architectures.
gap-63f82c0e6ce21a41099ec3758982ce6a576b.resolution_note: Added the Golgi-associated vesicle membrane as the direct whole-vesicle part and used COPI only as a curated child example.

gap-63fd498a13996205f24dcb3ca9982c7335cc.prompt: Do not model the Gtr1/Gtr2 Rag-family GTPases as constituent GATOR1/SEACIT subunits.
gap-63fd498a13996205f24dcb3ca9982c7335cc.rationale: Panchaud et al. 2013 identified Iml1/Npr2/Npr3 as the yeast GATOR1/SEACIT counterpart that acts as a GAP for the Rag-family GTPase Gtr1, while GO:1990130 defines the Saccharomyces cerevisiae GATOR1/SEACIT complex itself as Iml1p, Npr2p and Npr3p.
gap-63fd498a13996205f24dcb3ca9982c7335cc.resolution_note: Declined: Gtr1 was included as the non-component Rag-family GAP target for graph context instead of as a constituent.

gap-6412361d45b977dafa0aecf6ec082d9f962a.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for Golgi SNARE trafficking proteins and resident glycosylation enzymes, or split the grouped cohorts where exact family terms exist.
gap-6412361d45b977dafa0aecf6ec082d9f962a.rationale: This first Golgi apparatus record avoids broad SNARE or glycosyltransferase domain groundings that would overclaim exact identity for Golgi-specific protein cohorts.

gap-6416856a91d6e43063f366a7ca9ec85fa814.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for the Sm ring, SF3a, SF3b and U2-specific protein families that form the U2 snRNP.
gap-6416856a91d6e43063f366a7ca9ec85fa814.rationale: The first GO:0005686 record captures U2 snRNA and the GO-defined Sm ring at coarse granularity. Individual spliceosomal Sm proteins, SF3a, SF3b and U2-specific protein-family boundaries should be resolved before splitting this inventory.

gap-643d8f48d0807f8dd611fe561518ae33e62e.prompt: Keep dinoflagellate hypocone separate from the dinoflagellate epicone unless curating the posterior GO:0097614 class.
